## Intent — what this is for

Corrects PHF-6's census (scripts/generate_inert_surface_baseline.py), whose enum detector documented its own error direction as "never a false red" and then produced one. Whole-enum iteration reaches every member by construction, so one iteration site now clears every member of the iterated class; resolution is import-aware so one of the seven Verdict enums cannot clear another's members. The generator states the detected shapes, the honest trade (more under-reporting bought for the elimination of this false-red class), and the KNOWN remaining false-red shape. Baseline regenerated by the tool, every delta accounted for against the code. The shrink-only forbidden-to-raise ratchet is untouched.
